label: preparing
what: A privately organised catering order or gathering involving a large bread provision, possibly connected to the great hall and my forty years of service, though its occasion is unconfirmed. Builder, freight and innkeeper are coordinating grain, financing or barter, baking and transport; fifty-seven loaves remain needed. Baker knowingly permits use of his oven with their own wheat. The donated hall lighting may be related, but I have no direct confirmation that secretary or neighbour knows the undisclosed purpose.
